fullPassage: A temple dedicated to Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, was uncovered in the Greek coastal town of Amarynthos, ending a search that began in the 19th century. For over 100 years, archaeologists had believed the temple was located about 1.5 kilometers from the city of Eretria because this was how Strabo, a geographer from the 1st century, described it in his writings. Consequently, they conducted numerous excavations around Eretria, but with no success. It was not until a team from the Swiss Archaeological School discovered stones characteristic of Greek temple architecture in a Byzantine church further than 1.5 kilometers outside of Eretria that they began to think that the ancient geographer had been mistaken. The stones, they believed, may have come from the temple they were seeking as it was common for builders of the time to take material from ruins to use in new construction. This led them to shift the focus of their search closer to the vicinity of the church. In 2012, about 11 kilometers away from the initially indicated location, they discovered a gallery, which they later proved formed part of the temple.

questions.passage: A temple dedicated to Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, was uncovered in the Greek coastal town of Amarynthos, ending a search that began in the 19th century. For over 100 years, archaeologists had believed the temple was located about 1.5 kilometers from the city of Eretria because this was how Strabo, a geographer from the 1st century, described it in his writings. Consequently, they conducted numerous excavations around Eretria, but with no success. It was not until a team from the Swiss Archaeological School discovered stones characteristic of Greek temple architecture in a Byzantine church further than 1.5 kilometers outside of Eretria that they began to think that the ancient geographer had been mistaken. [조건] (1) ancient, been, geographer, had, mistaken, the 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 과거완료 수동: the ancient geographer + had been + mistaken
det.analysis:
주어 the ancient geographer(그 고대 지리학자)를 먼저 놓아요. '틀렸었다'는 지금 생각하는 시점보다 더 앞선 일이라 과거완료를 쓰고, '틀린 상태로 여겨지는' 수동의 뜻이므로 had been + 과거분사 mistaken을 붙여요
→ the ancient geographer had been mistaken
det.tip: 과거완료 수동 = had been + 과거분사(had been mistaken)
